name: event-bridge
description: Sends session, turn, attention and tool events to a host program over HTTP and, when allowed, takes prompts and interrupts back.

url.title: Host URL
url.description: Base URL of the host's listener, such as http://127.0.0.1:47800. CLAUDE_EVENTS_URL overrides it. Empty leaves the mod idle.

token.title: Host token
token.description: Shared secret sent as a bearer token on every request. CLAUDE_EVENTS_TOKEN overrides it. Host commands and host permissions need it, each turned on by its own option.

toolDetail.title: Tool detail
toolDetail.description: summary cuts long strings in tool inputs and results to 2 KB; full sends them whole, up to 1 MiB per event. CLAUDE_EVENTS_TOOLS overrides it.

hostPermissions.title: Host answers permission asks
hostPermissions.description: Lets the host allow or deny a tool call that would otherwise ask. Needs the token. CLAUDE_EVENTS_PERMISSIONS, host or off, overrides it.

hostCommands.title: Host sends commands
hostCommands.description: Lets the host submit prompts, interrupt the running turn and show toasts in an interactive session. Needs the token. CLAUDE_EVENTS_COMMANDS, host or off, overrides it.
